existing_mapping.evidence: System manages parking lot details including unique attributes.
Administrator is responsible for editing parking lot information.
System updates available parking spaces per lot.
Gate Sensor identifies vehicles entering and updates the system.
System retrieves vehicle information from the gate sensor and looks it up in the database.
System instructs Gate Sensor to open barrier for known vehicles.
System provides instructions for client if barrier doesn't open.
Clients are guided to input personal and vehicle information for access.
The system uses uploaded images to extract vehicle details automatically.
Extraction module categorizes vehicle colors into predefined groups.
System ensures each vehicle is associated with a single client.
System opens gate barrier after client and vehicle data are updated.
Parking session details, including start time and vehicle info, are stored.
Clients drive to a designated conveyor, securing vehicles themselves.
Conveyor Controller assigns conveyors and calls for optimization.
System locates parking and conveyor positions using floor and coordinates.
Parking spaces have defined sizes restricting vehicle types they can accommodate.
Conveyors are assigned with a maximum weight capacity constraint.
Optimization routines consider parking size and conveyor weight capacity.
Conveyor controller updates system on completion of vehicle transport.
The system tracks and updates vehicle location continuously.
System sends SMS notifications with parking data to clients.
Clients can access parking details through system UI.
System disregards conveyors used after vehicle session end.
Clients use the system UI for vehicle retrieval processes.
Vacant conveyors assigned to transfer vehicles to the gate.
Clients perform payment transactions via the system's interface.
Payments are calculated using IRS-provided data.
Different pricing structures are supported per parking lot.
System maintains pricing history.
System routes payments via external gateway.
System is notified by payment gateway for approved transactions.
Receipts are issued upon client completion request.
Detailed transaction receipts for clients are generated.
A client club offering member-exclusive benefits is managed by the system.
Discounts applied automatically for club member parking.
Clients can register for the club using the system UI.
Club membership is free and lifelong.
Clients can select preferred parking lots with selection stored for audits.
The first session in selected lots is free for members during registration month.
System supports creation of various administrative reports.
Annual financial summaries are prepared detailing company income.
Annual reports provide detailed financial and parking metrics.
Report data is sorted by city and total amounts, aiding analysis.
Reports can be exported in PDF and XML formats.
Monthly reports analyze trends in club membership growth.
Club reports offer insights into membership growth rate and totals.
Monthly ordering used in membership reports for temporal analysis.
